presets.name: Natural tears
presets.description: A portrait gradually becomes tearful with visible tears and a subtle sad expression.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Create one continuous four-second close-up shot of the same person beginning to cry. Preserve their facial features, face shape, skin tone, hairstyle, clothing and background. Start with a composed expression. The inner eyebrows lift slightly, the eyes become moist and a little red, and the lower lip trembles gently. Clear tears form at the lower eyelids and roll naturally down both cheeks. Add a small natural blink and subtle breathing, with minimal head movement. Keep both eyes, the nose and mouth stable and recognizable throughout. Use soft natural lighting and a fixed camera. No hands covering the face, no exaggerated facial distortion, no morphing, no scene cuts, no text or logos.
